blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Rain or Shine turned back import-less TNT, 98-94, on Saturday to claim the final game of the PBA On Tour exhibition series in Candon, Ilocos Sur. Import Aaron Fuller and rookie Deo Cuajao scored the tying and go-ahead baskets, respectively, to give Rain or Shine a comeback win at Candon City Arena. The Elasto Painters prevailed despite trailing by double figures in the fourth quarter. Stanley Pringle, who had been out for most of the season with an injury, saw action in the exhibition while Adrian Nocum didn’t play after suiting up for Gilas Pilipinas in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.
